question: The ratio of the curved surface area and volume of a closed cylinder is 4 : 5. If its total surface area is 187 cm², then its height (in cm) is (Take pi = (22)/(7)):
solution:
**Given:**

The ratio of the curved surface area and volume of a closed cylinder is 4 : 5

Total surface area is 187 cm²

**Formula used:**

The curved surface area of a cylinder = 2πrh [ r = radius, h = height]

The volume of a cylinder = πr²h

Total surface area of a cylinder = 2πr(h + r)

**Calculation:**

According to the question,

 2πrh / πr2h = 4 / 5

⇒ 2 / r = 4 / 5 

⇒ 1 / r = 2 / 5

⇒ r = 5 / 2 

Then,

2πr(h + r) = 187 

⇒ 2 × (22 / 7) {h +( 5 / 2)} = 187 × (2 / 5)

⇒ {h +( 5 / 2)} = 187 × (2 / 5) × (7 / 44)

⇒ {h +( 5 / 2)} = (17space × space 2space × 7)/(4space × 5)

⇒ {h +( 5 / 2)} = 11.9

⇒ h = 11.9 - 2.5

⇒ h = 9.4 cm

**∴ Height of the cylinder is 9.4 cm**
